headline: Executive order on how federal agencies review the environmental effects of transportation projects like roads, bridges, and transit.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with how federal agencies carry out environmental reviews for transportation infrastructure projects. It appears aimed at balancing environmental protection with the review process for building transportation projects. No official summary was provided, so the specific rules, deadlines, and responsibilities it sets are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that review transportation projects
who_it_affects.how: These agencies would follow any direction the order gives on how to conduct environmental reviews of transportation projects.
Groups planning roads, bridges, transit, or similar projects that need federal environmental review may see changes in how that review works.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 18, 2002; executive orders usually take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
